'''Sea crocodile''' are an enemy encountered on the third floor of the [[Temple of Aminishi]]. They are found along with [[Waterfiend (Temple of Aminishi)|waterfiend]]s in a big circle.

In Story mode their health is reduced by 50% and their damage output is reduced by 90%.
